name: ai-crm
description: Salesforce-style CRM built with NestJS, TypeORM, SQLite, React, Vite and Material UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-crm/api && npm run build -w @ai-crm/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:prod -w @ai-crm/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-crm/api && npm run typecheck -w @ai-crm/web
